title: The Golden Key, or The Adventures of Buratino
author: Alexey Tolstoy
short_summary: An old woodcarver named Papa Carlo carves a wooden puppet named Buratino out of a talking log, and the puppet immediately springs to life — mischievous, curious, and always in a hurry. Instead of going to school like Papa Carlo hopes, Buratino sells his schoolbook for a ticket to a puppet theatre and stumbles into a bigger adventure than he expected.
extended_summary:
An old woodcarver named Papa Carlo carves a wooden puppet named Buratino out of a talking log, and the puppet immediately springs to life — mischievous, curious, and always in a hurry. Instead of going to school like Papa Carlo hopes, Buratino sells his schoolbook for a ticket to a puppet theatre and stumbles into a bigger adventure than he expected.

Buratino discovers a secret golden key that is said to unlock a hidden door behind a painted fireplace, and a band of tricksters try to steal his few coins by promising to grow them into a money tree. With the help of new friends, Buratino learns to be more careful — and finally finds what the golden key was hiding all along.
